# TWIST-J

> TWIST-J is A. M. Thorn's falsifiable research program testing whether physical reality can be modeled by exact, deterministic integer rules. Its algebraic axiom is J = 1 + j², where j = exp(2πi/5). The discrete architecture is declared separately and has no fitted dimensionless parameters. Its physical decoder is typed and partial, and physical completeness remains open.

Use the Canon registry for the status of each claim and the activation record for the edition to cite.

## Core Machine-Readable Resources

- [Full Public Canon (Markdown)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mathorn1973/twist-j/main/canon/CANON.md): Complete public ledger of statements, status labels and supporting evidence.
- [Claim Registry (TSV)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mathorn1973/twist-j/main/canon/REGISTRY.tsv): Claim IDs, statuses, scopes, Canon sections, evidence and falsifiers.
- [Canon Activation Record](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mathorn1973/twist-j/main/STATUS.md): Active edition, release tag, content commit, SHA-256 and byte count.
- [Canon Core (Markdown)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mathorn1973/twist-j/main/canon/CORE.md): Stable entry point to the foundations and scope of the Canon.
- [Frontier (Markdown)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mathorn1973/twist-j/main/canon/FRONTIER.md): Open obligations and hypotheses.
- [Canon Releases](https://github.com/mathorn1973/twist-j/releases): Tagged editions for reproducible citations.
- [Kernel Identity Verifier](https://twistj.com/verify/kernel_identities.py): Python standard-library checks for the exact algebraic identities.

## Main Documentation & Theory

- [Program Overview](https://twistj.com/): The algebraic axiom, discrete state space, exact update U and one-way observation decoder.
- [The Kernel](https://twistj.com/core/): Exact identities, the 4 × 4 multiplication matrix M_J and the forward and inverse integer steps.
- [Public Canon](https://twistj.com/canon/): Web reader for the active ledger and its sources.
- [Research Questions](https://twistj.com/questions/): Results paired with open obligations and edition-specific citations.
- [Contact and Records](https://twistj.com/reading/contact/): A worked two-site theorem and a finite H3 archive computation.
- [RH at Augmentation](https://twistj.com/reading/rh/#augmentace): The scalar Möbius coefficients and the signed estimate still required for a derivation.
- [Papers](https://twistj.com/papers/): Deposited work with edition DOIs, full articles, source files and reader guides.
- [Twist Numbers](https://twistj.com/papers/twist-numbers/): Exact arithmetic in ℤ[j] and the integer J step.
- [Logos (Markdown)](https://twistj.com/logos/logos.md): Non-canonical interpretation with citations to the evidence it uses.
- [Logos](https://twistj.com/logos/): Web edition of the interpretation.

## Optional

- [Demo Lab](https://twistj.com/demolab/): Interactive illustrations of the arithmetic, including a five-step contact.
- [Evo](https://twistj.com/evo/): Exact finite checkpoint rules with an illustrative floating-point particle and field layer.
- [Pentaplex](https://twistj.com/pentaplex/): Penrose tilings and the Galois projection from ζ₅ to ζ₅².
- [Ordinary Quantum](https://twistj.com/oq/): Editable OpenQASM circuits with exact queries for supported operations.
- [Fractal](https://twistj.com/fractal/): Interactive Mandelbrot and Julia escape-time views.
